                                                                        on OE (5.7%). Adding balanced OE data in Stage 2 re-
                                                                        stores these abilities without harming structured accuracy.
                                                                        In contrast, GRPO-OE moderately improves OE (13.2%)
                                                                        but weakens structured skills. Overall, GRPO-Balanced
                                                                        achieves the best stability and performance across all tasks.

                                                                        three main contributions. First, we introduced PanoEnv-

while the accuracy reward continues to improve from a                   across five categories, built from synthetic 3D environments
lower starting point, indicating that the model now focuses             and grounded in precise, verifiable 3D annotations for re-
on harder OE reasoning without sacrificing the learned out-             liable evaluation and training. Second, benchmarking 14
put structure. Main Results. As shown in Table 2 and Ta-                state-of-the-art VLMs revealed major weaknesses in 3D un-
ble 3, our GRPO-Balanced model, representing our full                   derstanding—achieving only 49.34% overall and 8.36% on
PanoEnv-RL framework, achieves the best overall perfor-                 open-ended (OE) questions. Third, we proposed a 3D-
mance on PanoEnv-QA with 52.9% accuracy (vs. 49.3%                      aware reinforcement learning framework based on Group
zero-shot). It also attains the highest LLM-judge scores                Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), featuring a ground-
(Q-Score 6.24, P-Score 5.95) and boosts OE accuracy from                truth-guided reward with five geometry-aware strategies
6.4% to 14.8%. Combined with the reward trends in Fig. 4,               and a two-stage curriculum to ensure stable learning and
these results demonstrate that the two-stage GRPO curricu-              prevent forgetting. Our 7B model achieves state-of-the-art
